topic: People only know David Goggins for being tough, but he also uses deliberate strategies

artDirection.aesthetic: Script-led editorial motion with restrained, semantic effects
artDirection.canvasBackground: Selected per scene brief; no default HUD treatment
artDirection.narrativeStructure: Introduce Problem > Explain the Logic > Give the Solution (25-35s runtime, ZERO CTA)
artDirection.judyIntroDirective: Mandatory Judy pop-up at Frame 0 (0-3.8s) with floor reflection, smoothly exiting down before Scene 2
artDirection.antiRepetitionDirective: Each scene uses a distinct semantic visual metaphor, layout, and motion language
artDirection.easingDirective: Motion is allowed only when it reveals hierarchy, causality, progress, or transformation

judyIntro.title: PEOPLE THINK
judyIntro.notes: Judy waist-up delivers opening problem hook with eye contact, backed by radial glow and floor reflection, then non-linearly glides down.

designBrief.concept: People think David Goggins wins because he is permanently fired up.

visualMetaphor.description: One action knocks through a visible causal sequence.

designBrief.hierarchy: one dominant object, then supporting relationship, then caption
designBrief.typography: structural: type behaves as an object, not a title card
designBrief.depth: one foreground / one background plane only when it clarifies the idea
designBrief.color: one semantic accent plus neutral field; glow only when it communicates energy
designBrief.negativeSpace: reserve the caption exclusion zone and one intentional breathing area
